text: ばしょに　よって　よく　でる　スロットが　あるようね

structure.jp: よく　でる　スロットが
structure.en: slot machines that pay out often

patterns.name: 〜によって
patterns.explanation: によって after a thing says the result changes from one such thing to another. ばしょに　よって = 'depending on the place'.

patterns.name: 〜ようだ
patterns.explanation: よう after a verb says the speaker is judging from what she has seen, not stating a sure fact. あるよう = 'it seems there are'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: よく　でる　スロット
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a thing describes that thing. よく　でる　スロット = 'slot machines that pay out often'.
